images.caption:
This square, a city park in the North Beach neighborhood of San Francisco, is a good place to bask in the sun.

Even though it is late July, ocean breeze keeps things on the cool side, and low clouds are more likely than clear skies. Suntanning in bathing suits, while seen here, is usually an excruciatingly shivery affair.
